source.method: median over installed towns and castles of each child in its settlement gate frame (forward toward main_map_city_gate, side to its right), child transforms composed (position, rotation_euler as Mat3.ApplyEulerAngles, scale)

gate.rule: the gate stands this far from the centre, facing its road; candidates turn in 22.5-degree steps from the road direction

walls.rule: two breachable wall sections per wall level (Settlement.WallSectionCount is 2 for a fortification; SettlementVisual indexes its current level cache by the targeted section), each with a solid and a broken wall child

wallEngines.rule: wall engines per wall level, as the installed per-level copies (SettlementVisual keeps those whose level mask matches the current level)

scales.rule: the fortification circle (OnStartup takes its frame for the hover outline) and the camp areas (their spread bounds the besieger camp party positions) at the installed median scales

counts.bannerRule: 4 for a fortification and 1 for a village, each with one volume_box child (verified in game since MMR-33: a childless placeholder faults natively)

port.rule: a town port is its navigation port point (MMR-38); it must be water of its basin, within the travel graph port-to-gate limit; beyond the installed centre maximum is reported

dropoff.rule: a harbour village (the campaign's harbour flag) drops off at its MMR-28 harbour cell, placed at the cell's interior point nearest the village; it must be water of the cell's basin

ground.rule: a gate, camp, siege engine, ram or tower must stand on passable land (not mountain) of its settlement land component, within the slope limit and at least minMarkerSeparation from every other settlement centre and marker; wall sections and wall engines need land of the component and the same clearance from other settlements; candidates turn about the centre in turnStep steps, then shrink toward the centre by quarters; where no candidate meets the slope limit the least steep valid one is taken and reported; the pad slope above maxPadSlope is reported, not moved (the centre is the navigation point)

blockade.rule: the installed arc offsets in the port seaward frame, turned in 15-degree steps round the full circle and mirrored (start and end swapped, keeping the arc handedness), the frame moved seaward by half a cell and a cell, then shrunk to 3/4 and 1/2; every ship position BlockadePositionScript.GetBlockadeArc computes (randomization off) must be water of the port basin; otherwise no blockade visual
